title: vivo Y32 quietly launches with an 8,000 mAh battery
description: vivo has quietly listed the Y32 on its website in Bangladesh. The phone is obviously not to be confused with the Y32 from 2021 - we're not sure why the company is reusing the name so soon (or at all, really), but it is what it is. Anyway, the new Y32 comes with a 6.87-inch LCD screen with 720x1592 resolution, a 120Hz refresh rate, and 1,300-nit peak brightness, a 50MP main camera, a 2MP decorative sensor of some sort (probably a depth sensor), an 8MP selfie camera, and an 8,000 mAh battery with support for 44W wired charging. vivo Y32 in both colors The phone is powered by...

title: Watch the vivo V80 announcement live here
description: After announcing the V80 Lite at the start of September, vivo started teasing the V80 with promises of a phone that can capture “cinematic moments”. The date was set for October 6, so it’s finally time to reveal the new model. vivo V80's color options The company has already confirmed some key details for the vivo V80. It will have a 6.59” 1.5K OLED display with 144Hz refresh rate and a peak brightness of 5,000 nits. The phone will be equipped with a 7,200mAh battery with 90W charging. title: Another report says that the Xiaomi 18 Ultra has been canceled, reveals monster specs
description: After Xiaomi announced the Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max, it revealed that the two are headed for a global launch. That was a bit unusual, since the Xiaomi 17 Pro and 17 Pro Max never left China. Maybe this has something to do with the rumor from August that claimed that the Xiaomi 18 Ultra had been canceled. Now leakster Digital Chat Station is reporting the same – the Ultra is off the launch calendar. Apparently, it would have cost CNY 10,000 for a 12/256GB unit, which Xiaomi felt would have been too much and wouldn’t have generated enough sales. CNY 10,000 is not cheap – it...

title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max vs. iPhone 17 Pro Max
description: The new iPhone hit the shelves and the first order of business is to pit it against its predecessor. The Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max brings screen, performance, camera and battery improvements over the previous generation and yet the Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max gets you a lot of the same at a cheaper price. So how much better is the Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max? Let's look into it. title: OpenAI is adding visual ads to ChatGPT
description: OpenAI introduced ads for free and Go users of ChatGPT back in February. Those were pretty simple ads that appeared between chat messages. Now the company is adding a new ad format, which it calls visual ads. These feature larger images – either several thumbnails or one screen-width image. These aren’t live yet as OpenAI plans to introduce them later this month. This will start with a testing period where visual ads will only be shown when the user generates images with ChatGPT. However, the visual ads will be presented separately from the generated images and will be clearly marked as...

description: Samsung started rolling out the update to One UI 9 based on Android 17 for the Galaxy S25 family and the Galaxy Z Fold7 and Galaxy Z Flip7 in late September, and the update has made its way to the US over the weekend for the Galaxy S25 devices. title: Google Pixel 12 series screen resolutions are out and they paint an interesting picture
description: Although Google only launched the Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, and Pixel 11 Pro Fold in August, we already have a first leak about their successors. The Pixel 12 devices have apparently been spotted in the GSM Association’s database, and there's an interesting detail about them that's been outed - though we're not sure exactly how, since the GSMA usually only lists model numbers. Speaking of which, the Pixel 12 has the model number GC0QU, the Pixel 12 Pro is GWU59, the Pixel 12 Pro XL is G7U1Y, and the Pixel 12 Pro Fold is G4D5D. Somehow their screen resolutions have been...

title: Samsung makes its Galaxy A series devices more expensive in the US too
description: Last week, Samsung hiked the prices of its high-end devices in the US (along with Europe and India), and today the company has raised the prices of its low-end and mid-range phones in the US as well. Samsung Galaxy A57 We're talking about the Galaxy A17, A27, A37, and A57. The A17 is now $270, up from $200 when it launched. The A27 now goes for $380, up from $350 when it was released. title: The Galaxy S27 Ultra could be available in these base color options
description: The upcoming Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra’s base color options have leaked. The flagship phone is expected to be unveiled in a couple of months with a new rear camera design, a bigger battery, and the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset. According to tipster Ice Universe, the Galaxy S27 Ultra will be available in Black, Blue, Light Pink, and White color options. Ice also claimed that the phone will be available in a special Violet shade, similar to its predecessor. Leaked Galaxy S27 Ultra CAD render in Black We’ve already seen the flagship in Black through recently leaked CAD...

title: Infinix Smart 20E leaks in four colors, some specs outed too
description: Infinix launched the Smart 20 in March, and now it's apparently working on a companion device in the same family, called the Smart 20E. This has been leaked today in four colors, as you can see below. Its design seems nigh-on identical to the already available Infinix Smart 20. The Smart 20E has already been certified by the FCC with the model number X6843. That certification has revealed a version with 6GB of RAM and 128GB of storage, and the fact that the device will be 4G-only. title: Oppo K15s and K15x debut in China with familiar specs
description: The Oppo K15 series has two additional members in China: the K15s and K15x. While new in name, the pair share their key hardware with previously launched Oppo models. The K15s is a rebadged Oppo A7 Pro featuring the same core specs and design, while the K15x is basically an Oppo K14 but with a slightly smaller battery capacity of 6,500 mAh. Oppo K15s and its key specs Oppo K15s features a 6.57-inch AMOLED (FHD+ 120Hz) and MediaTek’s Dimensity 6360 Max chipset alongside up to 8GB RAM and 256GB storage. title: Huawei and Qualcomm sign patent cross-licensing deal for 5G, AI and other tech
description: Huawei and Qualcomm just signed a broad, multi-year cross-licensing agreement that covers 5G, compute, AI and networking technologies developed by the two companies. This is the first 5G licensing agreement between the two. As part of the deal, Qualcomm will buy several US patents from Huawei – they cover developments in compute, AI, networking and other technologies. This deal is subject to regulatory approval and Huawei has been subject to trade restrictions by the US since 2019, so we’ll see how the US Commerce Department feels about this. title: Gurman: touchscreen MacBook Pros are launching next month
description: The touchscreen MacBook has earned mythical creature status over the years, and we’re closing in on its debut, according to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman. Apple is expected to launch 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pros armed with touchscreen OLED panels sometime next month. While we’ve already seen plenty of leaked info on the OLED MacBooks, Gurman’s latest report specifies that the new laptops will be “significantly lighter” than the current models. title: Realme P4s Lite goes official with a 7,000mAh battery
description: The Realme P4s, which launched in India in August, is now getting a new variant. Realme appears to have quietly unveiled the P4s Lite in the country, with slightly lower specifications than the standard P4s. Realme’s new phone has been listed on its official India website, revealing its pricing, specifications, and availability. The Realme P4s Lite features a 6.75-inch LCD display with an HD+ resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate. It is powered by the Unisoc T7250 chipset, paired with LPDDR4X RAM and UFS 2.2 storage. One of the phone’s key highlights is its 7,000mAh battery, which...

title: Oppo F35 and F35 Pro debut with 8,000mAh batteries and 50MP selfie cameras
description: Right on schedule, Oppo unveiled the F35 series in India. They’ve grown heavier compared to their predecessors, the F33 and F33 Pro, since they bring bigger batteries. The new Pro is also equipped with a larger display, an extra camera and more oomph, while the new vanilla model can stop being envious of the Pro’s selfie camera. The Oppo F35 Pro now has a 6.78” OLED display, a 1,272 x 2,772px panel with up to 144Hz refresh rate. It renders 10-bit colors with 100% coverage of the DCI-P3 color space. It peaks at 1,800 nits of brightness in HBM mode and is protected by AGC DT-Star D+ glass....

title: Oppo F35 Pro hands-on
description: The Oppo F35 series launched in India in two flavors - F35 Pro and a non-Pro F35. We had the chance to play around with the Pro version, which is a feature-packed all-rounder, similar to the more affordable vanilla F35 in more than one way. Oppo F35 Pro While both Oppo F35 handsets feature 50MP main and 50MP front cameras, only the Pro gets an ultrawide shooter with 8MP resolution. title: Here's your first look at Google's next fitness tracker, the Fitbit Edge
description: Back in August, Google Australia accidentally revealed an upcoming Fitbit device in official promo images during the Pixel 11 series launch. Now, a new report has revealed the design and key features of the product, which is said to be called the Fitbit Edge. The report claims that Google will unveil the Fitbit Edge later this month, positioning it between the Fitbit Air and Pixel Watch 5. title: Beats 360 review
description: The Beats 360 are the newest pair of headphones from Apple-owned Beats by Dre, and are aimed specifically at those looking for a pair of headphones to use during workouts. They have a lightweight, durable design as well as IPX4 water and sweat resistance. The mesh fabric ear cups and headband are also removable and easy to replace, with multiple color and material options. The Beats 360 could also be seen as a more affordable alternative to the Apple AirPods Max 2, with many of the same Apple-exclusive features, plus Android compatibility, thrown in for good measure. title: Weekly poll: are you interested in the vivo X Fold6?
description: The vivo X Fold6 launched on July 1 in China and is now starting its worldwide tour – it’s already available in Europe and is expected to launch in India next week. So, now the question is this – are you planning on buying one? First, we have to look at the price and we immediately run into issues. vivo left the UK a while ago, the German site hasn’t been updated in ages. The company’s coverage in Europe is pretty spotty. title: Deals: here's how to avoid the Galaxy S26 series price hike
description: In case you missed it, Samsung increased the Galaxy S26 prices globally – in the US, they are $100 higher than they were at launch seven months ago. And even back then, most configurations cost more than the equivalent S25 models did last year. However, it’s not too late to pick up a Galaxy S26, S26+ or S26 Ultra at a good price. Your best bet at the moment is probably Walmart – not only has the retailer not applied the new prices, but it is even selling the phones at a discount compared to the old prices.
